The '''2011–12 [[Cypriot First Division]]''' was the 73rd season of the [[Cyprus|Cypriot]] top-level [[Association football|football]] league. It began on 27 August 2011 and ended on 12 May 2012. [[APOEL F.C.|APOEL]] were the defending champions. [[AEL Limassol]] won the championship one matchweek before the end of the season.

The league comprise eleven teams from the [[2010–11 Cypriot First Division|2010–11 season]] and three promoted teams from the [[2010–11 Cypriot Second Division|2010–11 Second Division]].

==Teams==
[[Doxa Katokopias F.C.|Doxa Katokopias]] and [[APOP Kinyras FC|APOP Kinyras]] were relegated at the end of the first stage of the [[2010–11 Cypriot First Division|2010–11 season]] after finishing in the bottom two places of the table. They were joined by [[AEP Paphos F.C.|AEP Paphos]], who finished at the bottom of the second-phase Group C.

The relegated teams were replaced by [[2010–11 Cypriot Second Division|2010–11 Second Division]] champions [[Aris Limassol F.C.|Aris Limassol]], runners-up [[Nea Salamis Famagusta FC|Nea Salamis Famagusta]] and third-placed team [[Anagennisi Dherynia]].

===Scoring===
<!--SOURCES WHICH EXPLICITELY STATE THE RECORD MENTIONED BELOW ARE NEEDED TO BE ATTACHED TO EVERY SINGLE ITEM. MATCH STATISTICS ARE _NOT_ SUFFICIENT!-->
*First goal of the season: '''10th minute''' – {{flagicon|BRA}} [[Edmar Lacerda da Silva|Edmar]] for [[AEL Limassol|AEL]] against [[Nea Salamis Famagusta FC|Nea Salamina]] (''19:10, 28 August 2011'')<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.cfa.com.cy/?lang=Gr&show=gamestats&GameID=17437|title=Nea Salamina 0–3 AEL|date=28 August 2011|publisher=cfa.com.cy|language=el|access-date=23 September 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110925024849/http://www.cfa.com.cy/?lang=Gr&show=gamestats&GameID=17437|archive-date=25 September 2011|url-status=dead}}</ref>
*Fastest goal of the season: '''37 seconds''' – {{flagicon|AUT}} [[Mato Šimunović]] ([[Anagennisi Dherynia|Anagennisi]]) against [[Apollon Limassol FC|Apollon]] (''11 September 2011'')
*Latest goal of the season: '''97 minutes and 34 seconds''' – {{flagicon|GRE}} [[Christos Karipidis]] ([[AC Omonia|Omonia]]) against [[Ethnikos Achna FC|Ethnikos]] (''4 March 2012'')
*First own goal of the season: {{flagicon|MKD}} [[Bojan Markovski]] ([[Enosis Neon Paralimni FC|Enosis]]) for [[Anorthosis Famagusta FC|Anorthosis]] (''17 September 2011'')
*First scored penalty kick of the season: {{flagicon|MKD}} [[Hristijan Kirovski]] ([[Apollon Limassol FC|Apollon]]) against [[Anagennisi Dherynia]] (''11 September 2011'')
*Most scored goals in a single fixture – '''23 goals''' (Fixture 20)
**Fixture 20 results: [[AEK Larnaca F.C.|AEK]] 2–1 [[AC Omonia|Omonia]], [[Anorthosis Famagusta FC|Anorthosis]] 0–1 [[AEL Limassol|AEL]], [[APOEL F.C.|APOEL]] 2–1 [[Ethnikos Achna FC|Ethnikos]], [[Apollon Limassol FC|Apollon]] 3–2 [[Nea Salamis Famagusta FC|Nea Salamina]], [[Anagennisi Dherynia|Anagennisi]] 1–2 [[Alki Larnaca F.C.|Alki]], [[Ermis Aradippou|Ermis]] 1–5 [[Aris Limassol F.C.|Aris]], [[Olympiakos Nicosia|Olympiakos]] 2–0 [[Enosis Neon Paralimni FC|Enosis]].
